items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One time Buhaina didn’t pay me.

ctx.x: Take matters into your own hands, so to speak?

Go to work. One time Buhaina didn’t pay me. I said, “Buhaina, you’re a big rough guy, but you’re a junkie and I’m sober. All I got to do is wait for you to start nodding, and I’ll pull out my baseball bat...,” heh-heh-heh...
